foundry_calls.text: Guarding? Nuffink! Just... watching the stores, is all. Tall folk always wants the stores.
foundry_calls.speaker: Goblin

foundry_calls.text: Its eyes keep flicking to the sack at its feet — something inside clinks.
foundry_calls.speaker: Sage

llm_calls: [Aria]: I lower my sword and ask the goblin what it's guarding.
